text.en: Feedback regarding the boutique's in-store customer service shows contrasting perspectives. Several buyers praise helpful assistance with bespoke sizing and custom charm orders, while other shoppers describe unapproachable staff attitudes, locked doors during business hours, and dismissive customer interactions.

Client communications show divergent experiences over the past year. Satisfied patrons appreciate detailed sizing advice and swift turnaround on custom orders, but other visitors express disappointment when personal product preferences were ignored or when door inquiries were met with silence.

Pet owners consistently commend the exceptional craftsmanship and durability of the boutique's handmade leather collars. Reviewers describe the leather goods and custom charm designs as stunning, sturdy, and well worth the investment, frequently noting that previous purchases lasted over a decade.

q.en: Are collars made to order at Holly&Lil?

a.en: Yes, the boutique specializes in handmade British leather collars, offering bespoke sizing advice and decorative charm additions.

q.en: Does Holly&Lil provide grooming services on site?

a.en: Yes, the shop operates an on-site grooming parlour alongside its retail boutique on Tower Bridge Road.

q.en: Can customers purchase accessories directly in the shop?

a.en: Yes, the store carries handmade collars, leads, harnesses, and pet accessories, though visitors note door entry procedures may vary.
